items.title: Add `default` option for `consistent-import`
items.body:
### 🧩 Description

The `consistent-import` rule allows specifying a single style of importing Zod, but it only covers two of the three ways to import Zod; it has no option to enforce a default import:

```
import z from 'zod';
```

### ✒️ Additional context

_No response_
